manual.title: Connect to the local network
manual.description: Home Assistant could not detect a suitable LAN address. Enter its local IPv4 address; the ports are configured automatically.

error.invalid_lan_host: Enter a private LAN IPv4 address

menu_options.firmware_updates: Prepare an older installation for updates

manual.title: Manual network settings
manual.description: These settings are only needed for a non-standard network or a port conflict.

interface.title: Sidebar visibility
interface.description: When hidden, open Settings → Devices & services → Anything to ESPHome → installer device → Visit. Direct path: /anything-to-esphome. Choose the language inside the installer.

firmware_updates.title: Firmware update profile
firmware_updates.description: Choose a monitor installed by an older wizard. Its Wi-Fi and fallback access point were not saved for later updates.

firmware_profile.title: Private firmware settings
firmware_profile.description: Enter the current Wi-Fi network. The old random fallback AP password was not retained and cannot be read through the normal API: choose its name and password again. These values take effect at the next firmware update. API and OTA keys are retained. Values stay in HA’s private journal, are not sent to GitHub, and saving this form does not change the monitor.

data.confirm_profile: Use this Wi-Fi and the new fallback access point settings at the next update

error.invalid_lan_host: Enter a private LAN IPv4 address

error.firmware_admin_required: A Home Assistant administrator must start firmware installation.
error.firmware_update_failed: Firmware update did not finish. Check the device and the saved attempt before continuing; no automatic resend is allowed.
error.invalid_catalog: The firmware catalog is invalid. No firmware was sent.
error.invalid_asset_url: The release asset does not belong to an immutable release in the project repository.
error.firmware_download_failed: Could not download the public firmware release.
error.firmware_asset_mismatch: The firmware bytes, version or template manifest do not match the release. No firmware was sent.
error.firmware_update_busy: A firmware operation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
error.update_profile_required: Prepare this older installation’s private firmware profile in Anything to ESPHome → Configure. Keep passwords in that Home Assistant form.
error.update_profile_invalid: Check the Wi-Fi and fallback access point fields. SSID: 1–32 UTF-8 bytes; Wi-Fi password: up to 63 bytes; access point password: 8–63 bytes.
error.update_unmanaged_firmware: The running firmware differs from the installer’s verified public version. Automatic adoption of a private or manual build is not supported.
error.update_identity_mismatch: The encrypted device identity does not match this installation. No new firmware was sent.
error.update_device_unavailable: Could not read the exact device and all required settings over its encrypted API.
error.update_usb_required: Connect this monitor to USB power before installing firmware.
error.update_sensor_check_failed: Repeated real CO₂, raw temperature and raw humidity readings were not confirmed. Inspect the device; the firmware has not been resent.
error.update_settings_changed: Settings differ from the values recorded before this update. Inspect the device; the firmware has not been resent.
error.update_verification_required: The saved update attempt is not yet verified. Keep the monitor powered and reachable, then use Update again to check that same attempt. This check does not resend firmware. If the old firmware remains, review is required before another transfer.
error.update_not_applicable: This release is not a newer supported firmware for this device profile.
error.update_catalog_changed: The public release changed during preparation. Refresh the firmware information before continuing; no firmware was sent.
error.ota_encryption_unavailable: This Home Assistant SDK cannot provide the required encrypted OTA handshake. Update the integration/Home Assistant; plaintext transfer is disabled.
error.ota_encryption_required: The device did not agree to encrypted OTA. No authentication or firmware bytes were sent.
error.ota_protocol_error: The encrypted OTA exchange did not match the expected protocol. Inspect the saved attempt before continuing.
error.ota_authentication_failed: Encrypted OTA authentication failed. No alternate key or plaintext transfer was attempted.
error.ota_transfer_uncertain: The OTA result is unknown. Keep the device powered and use Update to verify the saved attempt; firmware will not be automatically resent.
